title: Documentation policy: missing-doc, doc-placeholder, doc-malformed-summary
summary: missing-doc covers DFM-bound handlers with code; doc-placeholder (ON, hint) flags template summaries; doc-malformed-summary (OFF) flags declaration-like ones
intro: Read this to see which declarations missing-doc expects a doc comment on after 1.52 (a bound Button1Click with code now needs one, an empty one does not), and how doc-placeholder and doc-malformed-summary catch summaries that are not descriptions.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint lint-all --db <db> [--rule missing-doc|doc-placeholder|doc-malformed-summary] (documentation rules: missing-doc OFF by default, document all real code, an empty DFM-bound handler is exempt; doc-placeholder ON hint; doc-malformed-summary OFF hint)
